text:
rachel: Observed a reproducible numeric reordering in q4 quantized builds when mixing Simplified Chinese chapter markers with Arabic-Indic numerals. Seen on canary and local bench.

rachel: Minimal repro (canary tide-v1.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"tide-v1.q4","input":"第12章 (الفصل ١٢): 概要"}'
```

rachel: expected: 第12章 (الفصل ١٢): 概要
rachel: observed: 第21章 (الفصل ١٢): 概要  <-- the Arabic-Indic digits inside parentheses are fine, but the CJK ordinal digits got swapped (12 -> 21) after quant. BLEU on mixed-num-set drops 8.4 -> 5.0 for q4.

amir: wow. tokenizer dump + token positions? want to see if token boundaries or kvcache indices are changing.

pei: token dump from canary q4 run:
```
tokens: ["第","12","章"," ","(","الفصل"," ","١٢",",)"," :"," ","概要"]
classes: [CJK_NUM,EN_NUM,CJK,WS,ON,ARABIC,WS,AR_NUM,ON,ON,ON,WS,CJK]
```

pei: note: tokenizer emits "12" as a single EN_NUM token next to CJK; Arabic-Indic "١٢" is AR_NUM token. In q4 runtime the mapping between the EN_NUM token and kvcache index looks shifted causing reassembly to pick bytes from adjacent token and produce reversed digits. int8/fp16 are clean.

amir: can reproduce locally with synthetic set. int8 and fp16 return correct ordering. q4-only. starting bisect on q4 kernel commits.

l10n-bot: created dataset "cjk-ar-num-swap" (900 examples) covering CJK ordinals + Arabic-Indic numerals in parentheses and inline. Baseline eval: tide-v1.fp16 BLEU 8.4; tide-v1.q4 BLEU 5.0; tide-v1.int8 BLEU 8.2. Fail list saved to /datasets/locale-onboard/cjk-ar-num-swap/fails-3345678901.json

ci-bot: kicked off bisect job job-9910 across q4 kernel patches. ETA ~40m.

amir: early bisect narrows to the short-token packing patch that changed token->byte alignment for small numeric tokens. hypothesis: alignment shift causes off-by-one kvcache index into adjacent token bytes which reorder multi-digit numbers.

pei: can we add asserts in the kvcache index builder for EN_NUM and AR_NUM classes so we catch this in unit tests? also add a synthetic test with multi-digit tokens near CJK.

amir: adding asserts and running A/B with alignment disabled for EN_NUM tokens.

ci-bot: bisect complete. culprit confirmed: commit 0a9f2e (short-token align change). q4 build with EN_NUM packing disabled shows no swap in A/B.

rachel: excellent. please push hotfix toggle and add a canary routing rule that prefers int8/FP16 for requests containing CJK ordinals + RTL/AR_NUM until stable.

amir: hotfix pushed: q4-preserve-en-num-align. deploying to canary now.

ops-bot: Canary deploy tide-v1.q4-hotfix created by amir. ID: deploy-9127.

ci-bot: Locale regression results: cjk-ar-num-swap BLEU: tide-v1.q4-hotfix 8.1 (baseline fp16 8.4). Sample checks: no numeral reordering observed.

pei: opened PR #5210 with kvcache asserts, unit tests covering mixed CJK+EN_NUM/AR_NUM permutations, and a synthetic detokenization guard. Assign @amir and @rachel.

l10n-bot: request: add @mohammad and @chen for language validation on a couple of failing examples once we have a candidate fix.

rachel: saved failing examples to /tmp/tide-q4-cjk-ar-num-fails.json and left a 72h canary monitor. will escalate if any drift.

amir: also adding CI guard: run cjk-ar-num-swap on every q4 kernel change, fire alert if BLEU delta > 1.2.

pei: merging tests now, PR in review. thanks team.

rachel: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
